title: The Agency Efficiency Score
subtitle: How Much Profit Are You Leaving on the Table?

Fully automated qualification, scoring, and routing with AI enrichment

low.headline: Your Sales Pipeline Is Bleeding Hours and Deals
low.text: You are losing deals to faster competitors and burning your best people on work that should not exist. Slow response time alone is probably costing you 20-30% of inbound revenue.
steps: Set up an instant lead response automation that replies within 60 seconds with qualifying questions
Build an AI-built qualification flow that scores leads and routes only the qualified ones to sales
Automate proposal generation from intake data so SOWs go out the same day a call ends

mid.headline: You Have the Bones, Now Build the Muscle
mid.text: You have structure but humans are still doing too much of the heavy lifting. The next jump in efficiency comes from removing the manual steps between your tools, not adding more tools.
steps: Connect your CRM, calendar, and email so pipeline updates happen automatically
Generate AI research briefs before every discovery call so reps walk in informed
Move proposal creation to a semi-automated system that pulls from a reusable component library

high.headline: Your Pipeline Is a Profit Engine, Now Compound It
high.text: Your sales ops are running close to the frontier. The remaining gains come from layering intelligence on top of the automation you already have.
steps: Add predictive deal scoring so reps focus on the highest probability opportunities
Use AI to summarize every call and auto-update the CRM with next steps
Build a continuous feedback loop where won and lost deal data improves your qualification model

questions.text: How long does it take from signed contract to kickoff call?

answers.label: 2-3 weeks of back and forth
About a week
3-5 business days
1-2 business days

answers.label: Endless email threads asking for the same files

answers.label: Manually built from scratch every time

Fully automated provisioning from signed contract data

low.headline: Onboarding Is Where Your Margin Goes to Die
low.text: You are spending 20-40 hours of senior time per new client before any real work begins. Clients also lose momentum during long onboardings, which hurts retention before you have even started.
steps: Build an automated onboarding sequence triggered the moment a contract is signed
Replace email-based asset collection with a structured intake portal
Create a one-click project template that provisions tasks, folders, and access in minutes

mid.headline: Cut Your Onboarding Time in Half
mid.text: Your onboarding is functional but still depends on your team chasing clients and configuring things by hand. The next level is replacing those handoffs with automation.
steps: Automate the asset and information collection with smart forms and reminders
Use AI to draft the first version of brand audits and strategy docs from intake data
Trigger PM tool setup automatically based on the client tier and service package

high.headline: Polish the Last 20% of Friction
high.text: Onboarding is fast and consistent. Now focus on the experience and the data you capture during it, because that data fuels every other system downstream.
steps: Score onboarding completion in real time and flag stuck clients automatically
Pipe intake data into your content and reporting systems so nothing is re-entered
Add a client-facing dashboard so they can see their own onboarding progress

We reuse some swipe files but mostly start from scratch
Templates and SOPs speed things up

low.headline: Production Is the Bottleneck Eating Your Profit
low.text: Every deliverable is costing 2-5x what it should in hours. Your margin per client is probably half of what it could be, and your team is too maxed out to take on new work.
steps: Implement AI-assisted drafting for the highest volume content types (social, email, ad copy)
Build a design system with reusable components so designers stop rebuilding the same thing
Move review and approval into a single portal with automated reminders

mid.headline: Squeeze 30-40% More Capacity From Your Team
mid.text: Your production process works but humans are still doing too many low-value steps. Removing those steps does not require firing anyone, it just gives your team room to scale.
steps: Layer AI generation into your existing templates for first drafts
Automate platform-specific formatting and scheduling from approved content
Add an AI pre-review step that catches brand and quality issues before humans see drafts

high.headline: Industrialize What Already Works
high.text: Your production is lean. Now scale it without scaling headcount by turning your best processes into compounding systems.
steps: Train custom AI models on your client brand guidelines for higher quality first drafts
Build a feedback loop where revisions automatically improve your generation prompts
Productize your highest margin deliverables into repeatable, mostly automated offers

low.headline: You Are the Bottleneck and It Is Limiting Growth
low.text: Your team is reactive, communication is inconsistent, and reporting eats senior hours every month. Clients sense the chaos, even when they do not say it.
steps: Centralize client communication into a single channel with clear ownership
Automate monthly reports using your existing data sources
Use AI to transcribe and summarize every client call into shared notes and tasks

mid.headline: Move From Reactive to Proactive Communication
mid.text: Communication works but it still depends on people remembering to update clients. Proactive, automated communication is a retention multiplier.
steps: Launch a client portal with live project status pulled from your PM tool
Schedule automated weekly client updates with AI-drafted commentary
Route incoming client requests through an AI triage layer that handles FAQs

high.headline: Turn Communication Into a Competitive Moat
high.text: You already communicate better than most. Now make it a reason clients stay and refer.
steps: Add AI-built insights to your reports that recommend next actions, not just metrics
Use predictive signals (engagement, sentiment) to flag churn risk before it happens
Productize your client experience so it is consistent across every account, not founder-dependent

low.headline: You Are Flying Blind on the Numbers That Matter
low.text: You cannot fix what you cannot see, and right now you cannot see which clients pay your bills versus which ones drain your team. This is the most expensive blind spot in your business.
steps: Implement automated time tracking and tie hours to clients and projects
Set up recurring automated invoicing with built-in reminders
Build a basic per-client profitability dashboard, even a simple one beats none

mid.headline: Make Your Numbers Drive Decisions
mid.text: You have data but it is not driving real-time decisions. The next step is making profitability and capacity visible enough that your team acts on it daily.
steps: Connect time tracking, invoicing, and project data into one dashboard
Automate milestone-based invoicing so cash flow improves without admin effort
Document your highest-impact SOPs and link them directly to where the work happens

high.headline: Compound Operational Excellence
high.text: Your operations are tight. The remaining edge is using your data to make smarter decisions faster than competitors can.
steps: Add predictive capacity planning so you spot bottlenecks before they cost money
Use AI to flag accounts trending toward unprofitability early
Continuously refine SOPs using actual workflow data, not assumptions
